findings.title: Pause menu never renders in list view
findings.body: In AlertRuleMenu.tsx canPause is now OR of ruler and prom (GrafanaProm) abilities, but rendering is still gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. In the list view rulerRule is undefined by design, so even when grafanaPauseAbility is true the Pause item never renders. Users lose pause/unpause from the list.

findings.title: Delete menu never renders without rulerRule
findings.body: canDelete is OR of ruler and prom abilities, but the Delete Menu.Item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. GrafanaRuleListItem no longer passes rulerRule, so Delete never appears in the list even for users with delete permission, despite handleDelete path in RuleActionsButtons supporting prom-only identifiers.

findings.title: Silence action does nothing prom-only
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons now allows Silence via promRule ability and passes handleSilence to AlertRuleMenu, but the drawer is rendered only if `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` where `rule` is the optional RulerRuleDTO. When only promRule is provided (new list view) clicking Silence sets showSilenceDrawer true but no SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is ever mounted, so the button appears to do nothing.

findings.title: Missing key on Grafana list items
findings.body: FilterViewResults maps rules to GrafanaRuleListItem without `key={key}` while datasource and unknown branches pass key. The key is still computed via getRuleKey but discarded for grafana origin, causing React key warnings, incorrect reconciliation on pagination/filter, and loss of the duplicate-key protection the key was added for.

findings.title: Recording rules lose Export/Pause abilities
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on `isAlertingRule` (prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule). The old ruler-based version gated on any Grafana-managed rule (alerting or recording). Grafana recording rules have provenance/isPaused and should be exportable/pausable, so they now incorrectly get unsupported for those actions.
